meta.name: Driving Mom Crazy
meta.description: After criminals kidnap her baby, overwhelmed new mom Ruyi Zhang joins an unlikely crew of gangsters, ghosts and deities for a frantic rescue mission.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: An unexpected pregnancy upends the life of top livestream seller Ruyi Zhang, forcing her to confront painful memories as she questions her future.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: New motherhood overwhelms Ruyi until landlord A-Li becomes her unlikely lifeline. Unknown to her, a devoted ghost has enlisted him to help her.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A celestial mishap tangles the threads of fate as Ruyi and A-Li grow closer. Meanwhile, a lovestruck ghost enters her dreams out of jealousy.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ruyi uncovers Geek's deception after he takes control of A-Li. Left to cope on her own, she struggles as her life spirals into turmoil.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Separated from Taozi, Ruyi's postpartum depression worsens. As A-Li supports her, she learns why her mother was forced to leave the family.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Ruyi fights to reunite with Taozi, but a celestial ruling erases their bond. As memories resurface, she gets one last chance to restore her family.
